title: Health Ministry orders Nipah preparedness and border screening
detail: After Nipah cases in India, the Ministry of Health issued an urgent directive for symptom screening at entry points and isolation readiness in hospitals; experts said domestic outbreak risk was low.
attribution: VnExpress International

title: 59 Vietnamese returned from Cambodian scam-linked compounds via Tan Nam gate
detail: Cambodia handed over 59 Vietnamese (42 men, 17 women from 23 provinces) at Tan Nam border gate; authorities said they had answered online job ads and worked in compounds linked to fraud networks; 27 had crossed illegally.
attribution: Border authorities via Viet Nam News

title: HCM City court sentences four to death in ketamine ring
detail: The HCM City People's Court sentenced four defendants to death and others to life or long terms; prosecutors said the ringleader's charges involved over 60 kg of ketamine and 34 kg of other drugs, with ~43 kg of ketamine found in the first raid.
attribution: Court and prosecutors via Viet Nam News

title: Vietnam protests Chinese reclamation at Antelope Reef, Paracels
detail: MOFA spokeswoman Pham Thu Hang said any foreign activity at Hai Sam (Antelope) Reef without Vietnam's permission is illegal; satellite analysis cited by RFA showed ~1,490 acres reclaimed, enough for a 9,000-ft runway.
attribution: MOFA statement and satellite analysis via RFA

title: ONUS crypto platform founder and six arrested for fraud, money laundering
detail: Police arrested fintech businessman Vuong Le Vinh Nhan and six others over the ONUS platform, alleging counterfeit tokens and price manipulation since 2018; charges include property appropriation and money laundering. The platform went offline on March 20.
attribution: Police statement via Malay Mail

title: Early-April heatwave pushes Nghe An to 42C
detail: NCHMF said a western low-pressure trough and foehn winds drove temperatures past 40C in Son La (40.2C), Nghe An (up to 42C) and Ha Tinh, with the northern heat expected to last to about 12 April and central heat to 13-14 April.
prov: Nghe An / Ha Tinh / Son La
attribution: VnExpress International

title: Vietnam rejects China's East Sea summer fishing ban
detail: MOFA spokeswoman Pham Thu Hang called on China to respect Vietnamese fishermen's rights after Beijing announced a May 1-Aug 16 fishing ban covering parts of the East Sea.
attribution: MOFA spokeswoman via VnExpress

title: Vietnam coordinates with Indonesia, Cambodia over citizens in scam rings
detail: MOFA said Indonesia busted a fraud ring with 100+ Vietnamese and Cambodia detained about 5,000 people including ~500 Vietnamese; nearly 200 Vietnamese were received at border crossings since April 1.
attribution: MOFA spokeswoman Pham Thu Hang via Viet Nam News

title: Repeated night blackouts in Hanoi as heatwave drives record demand
detail: Hanoi's power demand hit a record 6,203 MW on 25 May at 21:30; residents in Thanh Xuan, Cau Giay, Long Bien, Hoang Mai and Tu Liem had 3-5 cuts of 30-45 minutes a night on 25-26 May, which Ba Dinh Power Company blamed mainly on the demand surge and local overloads.
agency: EVN Hanoi / Ba Dinh Power Company
attribution: VnExpress International

title: Police seize 23 kg of heroin and meth near Lao border; officer slashed
detail: Son La police seized 20 slabs of heroin and 30 slabs of synthetic drugs (23+ kg) and arrested a Lao national; an officer was wounded by a knife and other suspects fled into Laos.
attribution: Provincial police via Viet Nam News

title: Vietnam, China, Laos, Myanmar launch joint anti-drug crackdown
detail: Four countries' security ministries launched a June 15-Sept 15 crackdown on border drug routes; MPS cited a Vietnam-Laos case seizing 50.7 tonnes of caffeine, enough for 150+ tonnes of meth tablets.
attribution: Ministry of Public Security via Viet Nam News

title: Over 400 arrested in MPS operation 126N drug crackdown
detail: MPS said Operation 126N arrested 400+ people in 11 provinces, seizing ~90 kg synthetic drugs, 6+ kg heroin, 6,386 ecstasy pills, 7 firearms and ~VND4.5 billion (US$172,000) cash.
attribution: Ministry of Public Security via VnExpress

title: Ninh Binh police dismantle Cambodia-based fraud ring behind VND250bn losses
detail: Ninh Binh police said raids on June 23 detained 12 suspects (6 charged) in a ring that recruited Vietnamese to work in Cambodia and defrauded ~500 victims of over VND250 billion (US$9.6 million) by impersonating police, prosecutors and bank staff.
attribution: Ninh Binh police via VOV

title: Mandatory health declarations for travellers take effect
detail: Government Decree 165 requires inbound, outbound and transit travellers to submit health declarations within seven days before crossing borders from 1 July, with covered diseases set by the Health Minister.
agency: Government of Vietnam / Ministry of Health
attribution: VnExpress International

title: Tropical Storm Maysak (Storm No.1) nears northern coast
detail: Forecasters expected Maysak to cross the Gulf of Tonkin and land between Quang Ninh and Guangxi, with gusts to level 11 at sea and over 500 mm rain locally; border guards alerted 56,000+ vessels carrying ~250,000 people.
place: Gulf of Tonkin / Quang Ninh coast
agency: Ministry of Agriculture and Environment / NCHMF
attribution: Forecast and Deputy Minister Nguyen Hoang Hiep's directives via Viet Nam News

title: Emergency declared over rain damage on Ho Chi Minh Road in Tuyen Quang
detail: The Ministry of Construction declared an emergency after June rains and landslides deformed the Ho Chi Minh Road at Km115 (overlapping National Highway 2C) and Km124-128 in Tuyen Quang.
attribution: Ministry of Construction via Viet Nam News

title: Sleeper bus bursts into flames after crash on Highway 1; 7 dead
detail: A 24-berth sleeper bus left National Highway 1 in Hung Thinh commune around 02:30, hit two embankments and caught fire, killing 7 and injuring 5; firefighters put out the blaze in about 30 minutes. Other reports said the driver admitted drowsiness.
attribution: VnExpress International

title: 2026 disasters: 52 dead or missing so far, PM warns of more floods
detail: A PM dispatch said natural disasters in 2026 had left 52 dead or missing, 80 injured, 173 houses collapsed and 23,200+ damaged, and warned of 150-300 mm (locally 450+ mm) rain on Aug 17-21 in the north.
agency: Prime Minister (dispatch signed by Deputy PM Ho Quoc Dung)
attribution: Government dispatch via VietnamPlus

title: PM orders urgent flood response across 19 northern provinces
detail: Floods cut roads, destroyed temporary bridges and isolated villages in Tam Thai commune, Nghe An; PM Le Minh Hung directed 19 provinces to respond as a Gulf of Tonkin depression threatened more rain.
agency: Prime Minister / National Steering Committee for Civil Defence
attribution: Government directive via Viet Nam News

title: Stalled Gulf of Tonkin storm threatens 600 mm rain in Quang Ninh, Hai Phong
detail: NCHMF forecast 250-350 mm and over 600 mm locally for Quang Ninh and Hai Phong as a slow-moving storm (sustained 74 kph) stalled in the Gulf of Tonkin; the PM ordered vessel security and evacuations.
attribution: NCHMF forecast via VnExpress

title: Storm Narra rains kill one in Lang Son landslide, flood 2,506 homes
detail: Storm Narra's rain killed one person in a landslide in Thai Binh commune, Lang Son; the disaster authority reported 2,506 homes flooded, 205 roofs damaged and ~7,900 ha of crops hit. The storm itself was forecast to land in Guangxi, China.
agency: Vietnam Disaster and Dyke Management Authority
attribution: Disaster and Dyke Management Authority figures via VnExpress

title: Vietnam demands China stop reclamation at Antelope Reef and Yagon Island
detail: MOFA said Chinese reclamation and construction at Hai Sam (Antelope) Reef and Ba Ba (Yagon) Island in the Paracels were illegal and null and void, demanding they cease immediately.
attribution: MOFA spokeswoman Pham Thu Hang via Viet Nam News

title: 11 sentenced to death in 'VN10' drug case, Vietnam's largest
detail: The HCM City People's Court sentenced 11 to death and 19 to life among 227 defendants in a network that moved nearly 600 kg of drugs; investigators traced ~VND29 trillion (US$1.1 billion) in transactions. Alleged ringleader Ha Danh Nam was tried in absentia.
attribution: Court verdict via VnExpress

title: Lao Cai police raid Bokeo scam hub, arrest 91 incl. 64 Vietnamese
detail: Lao Cai police, with MPS and Lao police, raided an online fraud base in Bokeo, Laos, arresting 64 Vietnamese and 27 foreigners; police said the ring took over VND1.5 trillion from thousands of Vietnamese via fake social accounts and e-commerce sites.
attribution: Lao Cai police via Vietnam.vn

title: Floods inundate 16,310 homes in north and north-central Vietnam
detail: Heavy rain flooded 16,310 homes across Phu Tho, Thanh Hoa, Ninh Binh, Nghe An and Lao Cai; a landslide in Da Bac commune, Phu Tho, killed 3. Several rivers stayed above Warning Level 3, per National Civil Defense Steering Committee figures.
place: Da Bac commune (landslide); Thanh Hoa and neighbouring provinces
attribution: National Civil Defense Steering Committee and NCHMF figures via The Watchers

title: Bui River threatens southwest Hanoi; soldiers help evacuate
detail: Heavy rain submerged over 2,000 homes and isolated 1,000+ households, mainly in Ninh Binh and Thanh Hoa; hundreds of soldiers helped residents as the Bui River threatened southwest Hanoi, per disaster officials.
attribution: Disaster prevention department figures via Mongabay
